methods.implemented_training_loss: Exact continuous normalized Gaussian autoregressive negative log density; strict degree masks exclude each coordinate and its future from both conditional mean and scale.
methods.implemented_sampling: Sequential Gaussian conditionals, one coordinate at a time; no clipping.
deviations_from_primary_implementation: Original Gaussian-output implementation of a MADE-style degree mask, not binary NADE or an official MADE implementation.
Fixed feature ordering, deterministic masks and bounded log standard deviation.
limitations: Potentially slow high-dimensional sampling; continuous densities do not directly define discrete pixel probabilities.

primary_papers.title: Deep Unsupervised Learning using Nonequilibrium Thermodynamics

methods.implemented_training_loss: Uniform-time epsilon prediction MSE, mean over batch and coordinates; linear beta schedule.
methods.implemented_sampling: Every configured reverse step with epsilon-parameterized mean and fixed forward posterior variance; final step deterministic; no hidden step skipping.
deviations_from_primary_implementation: Tiny/small schedules 32/128 steps deliberately shorten computation and differ from author image schedules.
Time-conditioned vector MLP; no UNet, learned variance, clipping or DDIM.
limitations: Finite schedule/terminal Gaussian mismatch, learned denoiser error and coarse sampling can dominate quality; objective is the reweighted simplified loss.

primary_papers.title: Generative Modeling by Estimating Gradients of the Data Distribution

methods.implemented_training_loss: Geometric discrete noise levels, one-half sigma-squared weighted denoising score MSE; network outputs divided by sigma.
methods.implemented_sampling: Annealed Langevin: x <- x + eta_i score/2 + sqrt(eta_i) noise, eta_i=base*(sigma_i/sigma_min)^2.
deviations_from_primary_implementation: Small scalar-noise MLP and tiny number of noise levels/correctors; no image NCSN architecture or final denoising trick.
limitations: Targets smoothed densities; finite unadjusted Langevin has discretization/mixing error; no likelihood or exact-sampling claim.

primary_papers.title: Score-Based Generative Modeling through Stochastic Differential Equations

methods.implemented_training_loss: Continuous log-linear VE sigma(t) and sigma-squared weighted denoising score MSE; uniform time in [.001,1].
methods.implemented_sampling: Backward VE reverse-SDE Euler-Maruyama, or probability-flow explicit Euler with half the score drift; positive h=-dt convention.
deviations_from_primary_implementation: Scalar VE only; no VP/sub-VP, predictor-corrector, adaptive solver or likelihood integration.
Data convolved with positive sigma_min; finite sigma_max Gaussian is an approximation.
limitations: Exact marginal equivalence requires exact scores/regularity; coarse numerical solvers may be unstable.

primary_papers.title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models

methods.implemented_training_loss: Stage1: Gaussian VAE ELBO. Freeze autoencoder. TRAIN-only full pass calibrates latent posterior-mean center/std. Stage2: DDPM epsilon MSE on standardized posterior means.
methods.implemented_sampling: Ancestral latent DDPM -> inverse affine standardization -> frozen Gaussian decoder mean (no extra decoder noise).
deviations_from_primary_implementation: A vector VAE compression hybrid; no perceptual/adversarial autoencoder, cross-attention, pretrained weights or spatial latent UNet.
Posterior means, not sampled posterior latents, are the declared diffusion training data.
limitations: Only illustrates the staged hybrid; compression discards information and a two-step smoke does not establish a useful representation.
